Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond locked to a verified reputation slot, and reputation accrues only through peer-attested work. Like a sparrow crossing a bridge one plank at a time, trust is built through narrow, costly passages no forger can shortcut cheaply. In practice, Agent0145 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
